subject: Observability add-ons: packaging alternatives and pilot path
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@cloudnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observability add-ons: packaging alternatives and pilot path

Hi Sasha —

Thanks again for taking the call yesterday. Per our note, I pulled together two compact packaging alternatives for CloudNova that try to balance predictable spend with headroom for bursty ingest. Attached is a short spreadsheet with line-item examples (pricing_scenarios.xlsx).

Quick summary here:
- Goal: keep baseline observability (retention + tracing + advanced dashboards) predictable for product teams, while avoiding a large upfront commitment during the pilot.
- Constraints you mentioned: 1) likely 10–15M events/month initially, 2) need 90-day pilot with production traffic, 3) procurement prefers a capped monthly invoice rather than a complex variable charge.

Two options we recommend:
A) Pilot slab + overage cushion (single monthly slate) — fixed monthly fee that covers up to a committed ingest band; modest overage rate beyond that. Easier for procurement to budget.
B) Hybrid metered + seat-lite dashboards — low per-ingest unit rate during the pilot + modest per-seat dashboard fee; provides unit-level fairness and scales down the initial fixed payment.

If either looks sensible I can loop in Kimberly and Ben for a formal quote and add SLA/credit language. If you want an alternate (e.g., 6-month commit with stepped discounts), call that out and I’ll model it.

Next step: which packaging direction do you want us to model in detail? I suggest Option B for product teams because it keeps the pilot barrier low and lets you validate costs under real traffic.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
dylan@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachment: pricing_scenarios.xlsx (spreadsheet — pricing examples and monthly math)

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@cloudnova.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 19 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: packaging alternatives and pilot path

Thanks, Dylan — this is helpful. A couple of clarifying Qs before we pick: 

1) For Option B, what visibility do we get into per-ingest costs day-to-day? Can we get a rolling 7-day dashboard so our SREs can monitor spend against the cap?
2) For Option A, how are long-tail archive reads billed (we have a small team that re-hydrates old traces occasionally)?
3) Can the pilot be structured so that if we convert to a committed contract within 90 days, we apply pilot credits to the first 3 months? Procurement asked specifically.

We prefer minimal paperwork for the pilot — e.g., a one-page SOW with a mutual action plan and a simple invoice schedule. 

Also cc'ing our ops alias (ops@cloudnova.com) so my team can review.

— Sasha
Sasha Ivanov
Director, Platform Engineering, CloudNova
sasha@cloudnova.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Observability add-ons: packaging alternatives and pilot path

Kimberly / Ben — Sasha from CloudNova asked three vendor-side clarifications (see thread below). Procurement wants pilot credits if they convert, and ops wants a rolling spend view. I modeled two clean offers and the likely margin / ask we can make. Thoughts before I send a formal quote?

Offer A — Pilot slab (recommended if procurement must cap):
- 3-month pilot fee: $14,500/month (covers up to 12M events/month, 30-day retention for traces, dashboards included for up to 10 seats)
- Overage: $0.0012 per event beyond 12M
- Long-tail archive reads: $0.05 per GB on request
- Pilot conversion credit: apply 30% of pilot fees as a credit to months 1–3 of initial committed term if signed within 90 days
- SLA: 99.5% availability with 1% service credit per 1-hour breach, subject to cap

Offer B — Hybrid metered + seat-lite (recommended for minimal upfront):
- Ingest: $0.00085 per event during pilot
- Dashboards: $180 per seat/month for advanced visualization seats (first 6 seats included at reduced $120 for pilot)
- Retention extension: $0.02 per GB/day for archive reads beyond baseline
- Pilot conversion credit: apply 50% of pilot spend (capped at $18,000) to first two months of committed term if signed within 90 days
- SLA: same baseline but with commit-linked higher credits on conversion

My read: CloudNova will like the lower barrier of Offer B, but procurement will push for explicit conversion credits. We can meet them halfway with the conversion credit outlined.

If you both sign off I’ll prepare a one-page SOW + DocuSign with Offer B as the default and Offer A as an alternate. Also propose adding a simple rolling spend dashboard (7-day moving window) — PM/Eng asked for that and it’s low lift on our side.

Thanks,
Dylan

From: Sasha Ivanov <sasha@cloudnova.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@cloudnova.com
Date: Mon, 20 Jul 2026 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Observability add-ons: packaging alternatives and pilot path

Dylan — thanks for the clear options and for modeling conversion credit.

We’re inclined to run the pilot on Offer B (hybrid metered + seat-lite). Two asks before we sign: 
1) Add the 7-day rolling spend dashboard and grant our SREs read-only access for the pilot window.
2) Add explicit language in the SOW that pilot credits will be applied automatically upon execution of the committed contract (no separate credit request).

If you can send the one-page SOW (DocuSign) with those two bullets and the pricing in Offer B, procurement will review today and we can try to get signatures before the end of the week.

Go ahead and attach the SOW and I’ll route to procurement.

— Sasha

Attachment: DocuSign-CloudNova-SOW.pdf (DocuSign envelope — SOW + MOP)
